_meta.format: key -> { text, context, critical }. Parameters use {name} placeholders. Never concatenate fragments.

objective.first_capture.context: First objective shown in the HUD.

objective.go_to_portal.text: Walk to the glowing portal to start your first expedition.
objective.go_to_portal.context: Onboarding hint in the hub before the first expedition.

objective.explore_zone.text: Look around. Anomalies live in this zone.
objective.explore_zone.context: Shown on arrival in an expedition zone during the first build (capture arrives in a later update).

action.capture.context: Interaction label for capturing a creature.

action.enter_portal.context: Proximity prompt action on a portal. Short verb.

action.return_to_hub.context: Proximity prompt action on the return portal. Short verb.

portal.to_area.context: Proximity prompt object text. {area} is a localized area name.

portal.not_available.context: Sign on a dormant portal for a zone that is not built yet.

area.hub.context: Name of the safe social hub.

area.glitch_grove.context: Name of the beginner expedition zone. Green forest with violet glitches.

area.scrap_district.context: Name of the second zone: containers and repair bays.

area.void_station.context: Name of the third zone: dark laboratory.

status.safe_area.context: HUD badge: no PvP or cargo theft here.

status.expedition_area.context: HUD badge while inside an expedition zone.

warning.risk_zone.text: Unsecured cargo can be stolen here.

error.inventory_full.text: Your collection is full. Make room before capturing.

error.translation_fallback.text: Some text is shown in English.
error.translation_fallback.context: Honest note when a translation is missing for the player's language.

error.server_starting.text: The server is still starting. Please wait.
error.server_starting.context: Client waiting for the server ready signal.

error.server_failed.text: Something went wrong while starting. Please rejoin.
error.server_failed.context: Server initialization failed; gameplay is blocked.

error.portal_cooldown.text: Please wait a moment before using the portal again.

error.portal_too_far.context: Portal request from too far away.

error.portal_locked.text: This zone is not available yet.
error.portal_locked.context: Portal for a locked or unbuilt zone.

error.travel_failed.text: Travel failed. You are back in a safe place.

base.yours.context: Sign above the local player's own base plot.

base.owned_by.context: Sign above another player's base. {name} is a Roblox display name.

base.vacant.context: Sign above an unassigned base plot.

base.direction.text: Your base is marked with a cyan beam.
base.direction.context: Onboarding hint pointing out the base marker.

sign.extraction.context: World sign at an extraction zone.

sign.arrival.context: World sign at the safe arrival pad of a zone.

sign.welcome.context: Large sign in the hub center.

hint.move_keyboard.context: Key names are filled in for the player's keyboard layout.

hint.move_touch.text: Use the thumbstick to move and the jump button to jump.

hint.move_gamepad.text: Use the left stick to move and the jump button to jump.
hint.move_gamepad.context: Movement hint on gamepads. No button names: they differ between controller brands.

hint.dismiss.context: Button that hides an onboarding hint.

species.glitch_pigeon.name.context: Creature name. Gray pigeon with one segmented violet wing.

species.glitch_pigeon.description.text: A pigeon that sometimes slips sideways through space.

species.fridge_dog.name.context: Creature name. A small dog whose body is a refrigerator.

species.fridge_dog.description.text: Its cold breath makes the ground slippery.

species.siren_toad.name.context: Creature name. Green toad with a speaker-like throat.

species.siren_toad.description.text: Its loud call alerts nearby guardians.
